stem: One receiving rack shows noticeably different product condition than adjacent racks. What is the strongest record?
choices: Document the identified rack/lot and relevant environmental or product-condition evidence and escalate as required
rationale: Document the identified rack/lot and relevant environmental or product-condition evidence and escalate as required. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
